{{Top|leg}}
A '''flag hangar''' was a private [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], where a commanding [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] would stay when visiting a ship. In addition to the hangar, the admiral would also have private quarters near the hangar.

[[Booster Terrik]] kept the Flag Hangar on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' as his own, and met with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]], [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]], [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge]], and [[Myri Antilles|Myri]] after they escaped [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
